title: Why Shillong Should Be Your Next Travel Destination in Northeast India
content:
Shillong - Where Nature, Culture, and Adventure Meet

Nestled in the rolling hills of Meghalaya, Shillong is one of India's most beautiful hill stations. Often called the "Scotland of the East," Shillong captivates travelers with its lush green landscapes, mist-covered mountains, sparkling waterfalls, vibrant culture, and pleasant climate throughout the year. Whether you are a nature lover, adventure enthusiast, honeymoon couple, solo backpacker, or family traveler, Shillong offers an unforgettable experience. From breathtaking viewpoints and cascading waterfalls to lively local markets and delicious cuisine, this charming hill town has something for everyone.

In this complete travel guide, discover the best places to visit in Shillong, things to do, local food, travel tips, and why Shillong deserves a place on every traveler's bucket list.

Why is Shillong Called the Scotland of the East?

The title "Scotland of the East" was given during the British era due to Shillong's rolling green hills, cool climate, scenic valleys, and picturesque landscapes that closely resemble the Scottish Highlands. Even today, travelers are enchanted by the city's colonial charm, pine-covered hills, and refreshing atmosphere that make Shillong one of the most attractive destinations in Northeast India.

Best Places to Visit in Shillong

1. Umiam Lake - The Jewel of Meghalaya : Located around 15 km from Shillong, Umiam Lake is one of Meghalaya's most iconic attractions. Surrounded by green hills and forests, the vast reservoir offers stunning sunrise and sunset views.

Things to do:

  • Boating
  • Kayaking
  • Water sports
  • Photography
  • Picnics

The calm waters and scenic beauty make it a must-visit destination for every traveler.

2. Elephant Falls : Elephant Falls is among the most famous waterfalls in Shillong. Consisting of three beautiful tiers, the waterfall is surrounded by dense greenery and offers excellent photography opportunities. The short trek to the falls is easy and suitable for visitors of all ages.

3. Shillong Peak :  Standing at an elevation of approximately 1,965 meters, Shillong Peak offers panoramic views of the city and surrounding valleys. On clear days, visitors can even see parts of Bangladesh from the viewpoint.

  • Best time to visit: Early morning or sunset.

4. Ward's Lake : Located in the heart of Shillong, Ward's Lake is a beautiful artificial lake surrounded by colorful gardens and walking paths.

Visitors can enjoy:

  • Paddle boating
  • Nature walks
  • Photography
  • Relaxing amidst greenery

It is one of the most peaceful attractions in the city.

5. Laitlum Canyons

Laitlum Canyons is a paradise for nature lovers and photographers. The dramatic cliffs, deep valleys, and breathtaking landscapes make it one of the most scenic spots in Meghalaya.

The name "Laitlum" literally means "End of Hills."

This hidden gem is perfect for:

Trekking

Photography

Watching sunsets

Exploring untouched nature

6. Don Bosco Museum : The Don Bosco Museum is one of the best places to learn about the culture and traditions of Northeast India.

The museum showcases:

  • Tribal heritage
  • Traditional costumes
  • Artifacts
  • Local history

The rooftop skywalk offers magnificent views of Shillong city.

 Adventure Activities in Shillong

Shillong is an adventure lover's dream destination.

Popular activities include:

  • Trekking
  • Explore scenic trails around Laitlum Canyons and nearby villages.
  • Camping
  • Enjoy camping amidst Meghalaya's beautiful landscapes.
  • Water Sports
  • Umiam Lake offers exciting boating and kayaking experiences.
  • Rock Climbing
  • The surrounding hills provide opportunities for climbing and rappelling.
  • Cycling

Ride through winding roads and scenic countryside routes.

Local Food You Must Try in Shillong

Shillong's culinary scene reflects the rich traditions of the Khasi community.

Popular dishes include:

  • Jadoh (traditional Khasi rice dish)
  • Dohneiiong (pork cooked with black sesame)
  • Tungrymbai
  • Pukhlein
  • Momos
  • Local smoked meats

Food lovers will find plenty of authentic flavors across local restaurants and markets.

Best Time to Visit Shillong

  • Summer (March to June) : Pleasant weather with temperatures between 15°C and 25°C. Ideal for sightseeing and outdoor activities.
  • Monsoon (July to September) : The waterfalls become spectacular, but heavy rainfall can affect travel plans.
  • Winter (October to February) : Cool and crisp weather makes winter one of the best seasons to explore Shillong.

Overall Best Time: October to April.

Why Shillong Should Be on Your Travel Bucket List

Shillong perfectly combines natural beauty, cultural richness, adventure, and tranquility. From mesmerizing waterfalls and panoramic viewpoints to vibrant local markets and delicious food, every corner of Shillong offers a memorable experience. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway or an extended exploration of Meghalaya, Shillong promises breathtaking landscapes, warm hospitality, and unforgettable adventures. If you're searching for a destination where nature and culture blend seamlessly, Shillong-the Scotland of the Eastdeserves a top spot on your travel list..

This travel guide covers the best places to visit, local food, activities, travel tips, and everything you need to plan a memorable trip to Meghalaya's charming capital.
